limits: All API browser results are synthetic intercepted evidence, not a benchmark.
No live provider or coding-CLI calls were made for verification.
Human keyboard-only and VoiceOver acceptance not performed.
Physical device, cross-browser acceptance and a repeated live performance study remain outstanding.
Each real host needs its own adapter, egress policy, conformance checks and production evaluation.
